title: Airline Schedule Moves and the Penalty Withheld on Air Ticket Fare Brands
content:
What an airline move recorded on a booking sold under Air Ticket Fare Brands does to the penalty withheld follows how large that move was against the schedule-change threshold of the fare brand held, whether or not the move was large enough to give the traveller a right of its own.

**1. The thresholds conferred by each brand.**

| Fare brand | Schedule-change threshold |
| --- | --- |
| Basic Economy Lite | 180 minutes |
| Economy Saver | 180 minutes |
| Economy Classic | 120 minutes |
| Economy Flex | 120 minutes |
| Premium Economy Select | 90 minutes |
| Business Saver | 60 minutes |
| Business Flex | 60 minutes |

**2. The move taken.** Where the airline has recorded more than one move on the booking, the largest of the moves recorded is the one taken against the threshold.

**3. Terms.**

(a) Where the airline has recorded a move on the booking at or beyond the schedule-change threshold of the fare brand held, the penalty withheld is halved.

(b) Where the airline has recorded a move on the booking short of that threshold, the penalty withheld is reduced by a tenth.

(c) In any other case, including where the airline has recorded no move on the booking, the penalty withheld is taken as it stands.

**4. Either side of a threshold.** On a ticket held in Economy Classic, whose threshold is 120 minutes, a recorded move of exactly 120 minutes is at the threshold and the penalty withheld is halved, while a recorded move of 119 minutes is short of the threshold and the penalty withheld is reduced by a tenth. On a ticket held in Business Flex, whose threshold is 60 minutes, a recorded move of 60 minutes is at the threshold and a recorded move of 45 minutes is short of it. The same move of 90 minutes is therefore at the threshold for a ticket held in Premium Economy Select, where the penalty withheld is halved, and short of it for a ticket held in Basic Economy Lite, whose threshold is 180 minutes, where the penalty withheld is reduced by a tenth.
